decisions.user_confirmation: This is one melodic line, not reconstruction. The first two noteheads have no ledger line through them; the next C does.
decisions.assessment: Relative staff position, lack of ledger through the first two heads, the flat beside the second and the explicit ledger through the third support D-D-flat-C. Missing ledger alone would not prove pitch in a damaged scan; the surrounding geometry matters. The earlier speculative held-C overlay is not the preferred interpretation. The ledger argument alone does not independently certify every duration.

regression_plan_status: Recommendation for alignment; no runtime or prompt changes in this turn.
proposed_regression_plan: Keep the successful subscription harness/version pinned and selectable; develop the new policy as an opt-in candidate.

For each code change, replay saved drafts through deterministic validation for both execution paths without model calls; test corrections, true pickups, documented exceptions, stale decisions, overlays and warning retention.
Version source labels separately. Regrade both old output sets under a new label version without rerunning transcription; never overwrite the original reported metrics.
Bundle justified changes before a small paid candidate test. Include clear-control passages as well as known errors; record that these cases are consumed development evidence.

Before adopting the candidate for subscription production, run a small fresh subscription regression check on the bundled version. Archived replay cannot establish how a model responds to changed feedback.

Reserve full-score and broader-suite fresh runs for promotion or major changes; use an untouched score to assess generalization. Repeat live trials if a close or noisy result would change the decision.
limits: No guarantee of unchanged live model behavior from deterministic replay alone. The new completion policy must not force arbitrary rest padding or treat all speculative exceptions as resolved musical truth.

publication.scope: Only the personal filesystem path was removed; historical evidence and the original record remain unchanged.
